name: Lynaria Renwick
original_name: リナリア・レンウィック
source:
[i]"My apologies. I don't intend to lose."[/i]

[b]Race:[/b] Vampire
[b]Interest:[/b] Cleaning
[b]Weapon:[/b] Magic

An elegant, domineering, aristos vampire. She stands in the protagonists' way at the behest of Vlad, the king of vampires.

She is Oleander's sister and always by his side.
